question: Does the RC10 rainfall-associated expansion and boundary-biased incidence allocation persist when wetter-drier comparisons are restricted to the same recorded NAAMP observer?

sample.base: same complete 10-stop matched wetter-drier route x RunNumber pairs as RC10
sample.restriction: ObserverTrackingID must be nonempty and identical for the wetter and drier run

minimum_gate.action_if_failed: report coverage and retain observer turnover as a limitation; do not interpret inferential endpoints

headline_models: response ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber), cluster-robust by State x RouteNumber

primary_uniform_null.magnitude_matching: match each wetter run's observed species x stop incidence count

classification.observer_robust: minimum gate passes; all three headline rain-contrast coefficients are positive with 95% CIs excluding zero; the four-component omnibus rejects at P<0.05 for primary kappa=2 and primary anchor=0.75; and observed boundary crossing lies above the 95% null interval for both primary nulls
classification.directionally_consistent_qualified: minimum gate passes and all three headline coefficients are positive, while observed boundary crossing exceeds both primary null means, but one or more strong-support conditions above fail
classification.mixed: minimum gate passes but headline signs differ or observed boundary crossing does not exceed one or both primary null means

interpretation_boundary.purpose: address observer-turnover detectability as a reviewer robustness concern without changing the frozen RC10 story
